findings.note: ESPN's injury report lists Rangers goalie Igor Shesterkin on long-term IR, along with Bjorkstrand, Smits, Veleno and Dorofeyev, which likely leaves Garand (.909) or Korpisalo in net; the market has Buffalo as the favorite at about -135.

A Covers writer picks the Rangers moneyline, citing their 6-2 run, Korpisalo going 3-0 with a .940 SV%, and Buffalo's 3-6-1 slump with a .851 team SV%. Covers' no-vig estimate gives the Rangers only 46%. This is an opinion, not proof of an edge.
Dorofeyev (lower body) is traveling, but whether he plays against Buffalo is still unclear. The Rangers lost 5-2 to Carolina in their last game, and CBS lists Buffalo at -137 with a 6.5 total.
